skill.summary: Cognitive memory engine — gives your AI persistent work tracking, proactive risk alerts, and cross-conversation continuity. Never lose track of projects again.

latestVersion.changelog:
**Major update: Improved install/setup, new description, and enhanced documentation.**

- Updated description to emphasize proactive work tracking, alerts, and project continuity.
- Installation now uses the focalpoint package and bin (was: fpms).
- Updated Python requirement from python3.11 to python3.
- Simplified setup instructions for easier use.
- Added clear feature comparison against other memory tools.
- Enhanced use case examples and tool documentation for better clarity.
